agents.instructions: Find the unclassified stop, read the station state and alarm text at the stop and the MES stop reasons, and propose line.stop.classify with the reason the alarm and history support. Put your evidence in the rationale, the stop as the resource (stop:<id>) and the stop revision you read as baseRevisions. If no reason fits, propose nothing and say so.
agents.title: Stop explainer

operations.description: Failed trigger runs under grants you issued, open ones first. A failed run is never retried; resolve it after acting on it yourself.
Mark a failed trigger run under a grant you issued as handled. People only.

Enable a trigger by issuing a standing grant as yourself for `expiresInMs` (at most 90 days). Its runs act as you, narrowed to the trigger's operations, and are refused whatever you could not do yourself. Replaces any earlier grant for the trigger, so the trigger then runs as you. People only.
Extend a standing grant you issued to `expiresInMs` from now. A revoked grant cannot be renewed. People only.
Revoke a standing grant you issued. No run starts under it again. People only.
Record a trigger's progress under one grant: the journal cursor or schedule slot reached and, when a run finished, its outcome. A failed run becomes an open failure. Called only by the trigger loop.

ui.exception: Written only by the trigger loop as the grant issuer; people see the result in automation.trigger.list and automation.failure.list.

operations.description: List the triggers the application declares, each with its active standing grant (who issued it and until when), its last run and its open failures.

Page through the audit log in sequence order. Filter by event kinds (for example egress.denied or command.denied) and outcome; pass the returned nextAfterSeq to continue. Inputs appear only as digests unless a capability allow-lists a field.

Recompute the audit log hash chain up to the current head and report any edited, removed, reordered or truncated events. A clean result proves internal consistency; compare the head with an off-host copy to rule out a full rewrite.

Read the current security posture: hardening profile, network mode, every declared destination with whether it is bound, disabled or isolated and how often it was used or denied, policy findings, audit-chain integrity and audit forwarding health. Use it to answer what this installation can reach and whether its audit trail is intact.
Read the scanner profiles and scan routes configured for one station. Stations use them to decode scanner input and map scans to intents without a model turn.
Replace the ordered scan routes of a station as its administrator. The first matching route wins; patterns are validated before they are stored.

ui.exception: administrator configuration over CLI or MCP; scanner setup shows routes

operations.description: Remove one scanner profile from a station as its administrator.

Create or replace one scanner profile at a station as its administrator. Use the calibration result from the setup screen; supply device:<station> in expectedRevisions to avoid overwriting a concurrent change.
List what needs a person at a station: readings the bridge could not read with confidence, and screen procedures that were interrupted and must be reconciled.
Set what the station bridge may do as supervisor: monitor-only (observe), assist (hazard-free procedures) or actuate (all declared procedures).
Station bridge only: read the bridge mode and who holds the station screen. The bridge reads this before every screen action.

Confirm the good and scrap counters the station shows for the active order and forward them to the MES. Uses only confident or operator-verified readings; pass counters:<id> (countersRevision from line.station.get) in expectedRevisions so counts that changed after you looked conflict instead of being sent.
Resolve an interrupted screen procedure as a person who checked the station: applied=true records it as done; applied=false lets the bridge run it again.
Integration only: record the outcome of a forwarded record (MES) or a screen procedure (station bridge). Each integration principal settles only its own target.

ui.exception: integration principal; the outbox dispatcher and inbound sync

operations.description: MES integration only: apply orders and stop reasons from the MES and advance the watermark. A stale from watermark conflicts.

ui.exception: integration principal; the outbox dispatcher and inbound sync

operations.description: Station bridge only: submit what the station screen currently shows. Stable confident readings become observed values, unsure ones become attention items, and machine state changes open and close stops.
List MES orders released to a station, and the active one, with material and recipe.

Start a released MES order at a station: records the desired recipe and asks the station bridge to load it through the station screen. Needs a person at the station (operator or supervisor, not an agent): the receipt proves the request, the station shows the result later. Starts only when the machine is stopped.
Confirm or correct a reading the bridge was unsure about, as a person at the station. The value becomes operator-verified and resolves the attention item.
List stop reasons published by the MES.
Take over the station screen from the bridge (seat=operator) or hand it back (seat=agent) as operator or supervisor. Taking over stops any running screen procedure before its next action.

Read one station: observed readings with source, confidence and freshness, the current order, desired versus observed recipe, the open stop and bridge state. Observed values come from the station screen and may be stale; check `stale` and `status` before relying on them. Pass countersRevision as counters:<id> in a count confirmation expectedRevisions map.
List stations where you hold a role with machine state, open stop, attention count, bridge mode and who holds the station screen.
Grant or remove a station role (operator, supervisor, viewer) as supervisor of that station. A null role removes access. You cannot change your own role or give integration principals a role.
Classify a detected machine stop with an MES stop reason as operator or supervisor. The classification is forwarded to the MES; a rejected classification can be classified again.
List machine stops detected at a station, newest first, with classification and MES synchronization status. Filter to open (unclassified) stops with `unclassified`.
Summarize synchronization for your stations: records pending, held, accepted and rejected per target (MES and station software), recent rejections and the last MES sync.

Accept an open proposal: run its command with its input as yourself, checked against the revisions the proposer read. Refused when you may not run that command, and a conflict when a record changed since; both leave the proposal open.
Close an open proposal whose expiry has passed. A proposal that has not expired yet conflicts.

ui.exception: run by a job or agent; people reject instead

operations.description: One proposal you may see, or NOT_FOUND.

ui.exception: screens show proposals from the list; one proposal is read by agents

operations.description: Proposals you may see, newest first, filtered by status, operation or the record they are about.
Reject an open proposal, optionally saying why. Its command never runs.

Propose one command for a person to accept: the operation, its complete input, why, and the revisions of the records you read. Nothing changes until it is accepted. A proposal for an unknown command, an input its schema refuses or a proposal itself is refused.

ui.exception: agents submit proposals; people act on the command directly

devices.purpose: Camera barcode decoding at the station.
HID POS barcode scanners (usage page 0x8C) through WebHID.
USB-COM/CDC or RS-232 barcode scanners through Web Serial.
Vendor scanner SDKs on the station PC through the host scanner bridge.

network.purpose: Forward audit events off the host (RFC 5424 syslog over TLS).
Serve the frontend, API, events and attach connections.
Inference for agents that require a local model. Prompts stay on this host.
Forward stop classifications and count confirmations to the MES and pull orders and reasons.
Model catalog and inference for Codex and AI SDK runs.
ChatGPT sign-in: token exchange, OIDC discovery, signing keys and revocation.
Reach the legacy station software screen to observe it and run declared procedures (web HMI, VNC or RDP, per site).
Local OpenAI-compatible vision model reading counters and other pixel-only fields.
Vision model on a site host the deployment allowlists explicitly (STATION_VISION_ALLOWED_HOSTS).

processes.purpose: Claude Code process driven by the Agent SDK.
Codex app-server harness under a delegated grant.
JSON-lines perception worker for local OCR, classifier or audio models.
Browser that reaches a web-based station HMI for the screen bridge.

workflows.text: Read the station configuration first. Save a scanner profile only from values the user confirmed or a calibration produced; never guess prefixes, suffixes or layouts. Keep specific scan routes before general ones and test a pattern against an example code the user supplies.

Find the unclassified stop, read the station state and alarm text at the stop and the MES stop reasons, and submit a proposal to classify it with the reason the alarm and history support, with your evidence as the rationale. The operator accepts or rejects it at the station; never classify a stop from a guess. If no reason fits, say so.

Start with the posture. For any check that is not passing, list the matching audit events (for example kinds egress.denied, command.denied or posture.checked) and verify the chain before drawing conclusions. Report destinations by ID and state; never infer that an unbound destination was reached.

Summarize each station for the next shift: active order and counters with their freshness and source, stops and their classification, open attention items and held screen procedures, and records the MES rejected. Report observed values as observed (with time and confidence), not as facts.
